svg.title: CodeCrux system architecture
svg.desc: A React single-page app talks to an Express API over HTTPS with a JWT cookie. The API uses MongoDB and Redis, and calls JDoodle, Google Gemini and Cloudinary. The browser uploads videos directly to Cloudinary using a signature issued by the API.
svg.text: React SPA | Express REST API | MongoDB + Redis | JDoodle, Gemini and Cloudinary integrations
JS / Java / C++, one buffer per language
speed and quality via Cloudinary URLs
Session = httpOnly cookie (not readable by JS)
userMiddleware: verify JWT cookie, load user
JWT blocklist on logout / account delete
key: token:<jwt> TTL: until JWT exp
Compiler REST API: C++, Java, Node.js
one call per test case, 15 s timeout
DSA tutor with problem-aware system prompt
Direct video upload from the admin browser (multipart POST with a server-issued signature)
Solid arrows: request/response paths. Dashed arrow: browser-to-Cloudinary upload that bypasses the API.
